tools.name: analyze_portfolio
tools.description: Calculate manual USD portfolio allocation, concentration, hypothetical uniform/per-asset price shock, cost basis and mathematical recovery. No market prices, predictions or trades. Requires user-provided holdings and assumptions; remote data transfer differs from browser-only calculator.

tools.name: plan_portfolio_exits
tools.description: Calculate sequential proposed sales using manual unit targets, fees and average-cost accounting. Returns hypothetical proceeds, remaining holdings and recovery of cost. No orders, timing recommendations, market feed or tax accounting. Input holdings are transmitted to the service.
